Why work
at Tasq

We build infrastructure that enterprise AI runs on when it matters. Here’s what that actually looks like day-to-day.

01

The work is real.

Production systems, live customers, measurable outcomes. Not a lab. Not a demo. The systems you build are the systems that run when the cost of being wrong is measured in revenue or safety.

02

Direct ownership.

Short paths between problem and person. Operators ship product changes. No org-chart friction between you and the decision.

03

High bar, no theater.

We hire slowly and deliberately. Once you’re in, the standard stays. No performative meetings, no status decks, no “alignment sessions.” Just the work.

04

Remote-first, distributed team.

Teams across three continents. Async by default, in-person when it changes something.

Don't see your role? Tell us anyway.

We hire opportunistically across engineering, product, AI/ML, and operations.
